note: Canonical inventory with status layers lives at regulatory/inventory/sources.json. This file is the compact bank-only pin list for ingest.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
sources.why: Current recovery-agent conduct, fair practices, and calling-hour rules for commercial banks (paragraph 445 and Chapter VIII Section K).

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Managing Risks in Outsourcing) Directions, 2025
sources.why: Bank remains responsible for outsourced recovery; confidentiality and oversight of the voice agent.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
sources.why: Only if the bank product is digital lending — agent particulars by email/SMS before contact.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
sources.why: Replaces current commercial-bank recovery paragraphs on 1 January 2027.

sources.title: Outsourcing of Financial Services - Responsibilities of regulated entities employing Recovery Agents
sources.why: Paragraph 2 harassment and calling-hours instruction for banks. Paragraph 3 says these instructions supplement and must be read with existing RBI guidelines (Annex), so this corpus keeps 2022 together with the older bank recovery/outsourcing framework rather than treating 2022 as the only source.

sources.title: Recovery Agents Engaged by Banks
sources.why: Older applicable bank recovery-agent engagement framework listed in the 2022 circular Annex. Retained because 2022 supplements existing instructions.

sources.title: Guidelines on Managing Risks and Code of Conduct in Outsourcing of Financial Services by banks
sources.why: Older bank outsourcing framework listed in the 2022 circular Annex, including recovery-agent conduct expectations. Retained because 2022 supplements existing instructions.
